purpose: diagnosis only; no new method; no label-based hyperparameter or checkpoint selection

features.output: final LayerNorm CLS token, saved float32 (fp16 values)
features.preprocess_note: user explicitly requests resize224; official eval defaults resize256/crop224, overridden resize_size=224. Square CIFAR images retain full image.

subset.class_order: torchvision label id ascending, fixed across all seeds and IRs
subset.rng: numpy RandomState(seed), independently permute each class pool once in class order; take prefix; identical permutation across IRs
subset.tail: floor(K/3) classes with smallest counts; ties by class id ascending
subset.setting: transductive: fit and evaluate on same selected train subset; test features never used

BAL.head: single cosine linear head, bias=False, 768->K, random torch Linear initialization, normalized weights each forward
BAL.sinkhorn: uniform marginals, log-domain, 3 row/column normalization iterations, epsilon=0.05 on cosine similarities
BAL.loss: mean soft-target CE on logits=10*cosine, stop-gradient assignment; same cached feature as input and target; no augmentation or backbone tuning

P2OT_feat.solver: unmodified official utils/sinkhorn_knopp.py SemiCurrSinkhornKnopp loaded by absolute importlib path
P2OT_feat.wrapper: same head, initialization, permutation, optimizer, epochs, final checkpoint as BAL; official solver replaces uniform Sinkhorn; soft CE retains partial target mass
P2OT_feat.adaptation_limits: one head; no logits memory bank, no image multiview, no backbone tuning; module adaptation, not paper reproduction
P2OT_feat.on_nonfinite: stop and preserve failure; no tuning or deleting runs

ORACLE_KM.centers: mean of L2 normalized features by true class within current subset, NOT renormalized
ORACLE_KM.assignment: nearest centroid squared Euclidean, zero Lloyd updates
ORACLE_KM.caveat: operational supervised reference, not mathematical upper bound

LP.evaluation: resubstitution on same selected subset, supervised representation reference only; not generalization

evaluation.mapping: one global Hungarian mapping maximizing total correct sample count per run; shared by ACC and all subgroup metrics; NMI/ARI permutation invariant; LP also same global mapping
evaluation.cluster_sizes: all K cluster ids including empty; Hungarian aligned counts + raw counts; per-class true counts
evaluation.distribution: KL(p_true||q_aligned) with additive count smoothing 1e-12; natural log; also JS(p_true,q_aligned), JS(sorted p,sorted q), JS(q,uniform), normalized entropy

decision.best: per-seed max(KM,BAL) in balanced_accuracy, offline diagnostic envelope, never deployment selection; excludes P2OT_feat
decision.long_tail_loss: mean_s(best(IR1,s)-best(IR100,s)) >= 0.08 AND strictly positive in >=4/5 seeds
decision.room: mean_s(ORACLE_KM(IR100,s)-best(IR100,s)) >=0.05 AND strictly positive in >=4/5 seeds
decision.uniform_prior_harm: descriptive only: BAL-KM BA/tail mean<0, or BAL has smaller JS(q,uniform); all per-seed differences reported
decision.paired: same dataset, IR, seed; cross-IR uses same seed, nested class prefixes; zero not positive
decision.statistics: mean and population std ddof=0, no post-hoc thresholds or significance test; auxiliary CIFAR10 and IR10 do not alter primary

runtime.determinism: torch deterministic True; cudnn deterministic True benchmark False; TF32 disabled; CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8

audit.full_rerun: cifar100 IR100 seed1 all five methods in separate process using cached features
audit.recompute: all subset indices, predictions->metrics, counts and hashes; saved KM centers and heads->predictions; refit KM during full rerun
audit.feature_audit: finite shape/dtype and SHA256 all four splits; no second full extraction

label_firewall: labels used only for requested LT construction, offline evaluation and explicitly supervised ORACLE_KM/LP. KM/BAL/P2OT_feat training accept features,K,seed only.
